newsitem.title: USA: Centrum on mark for $0.25-30 FY97 EPS - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Centrum on mark for $0.25-30 FY97 EPS - CEO.

text.p: Centrum Industries Inc expects second quarter earnings of about $0.04 versus $0.02 a year ago and remains on target to earn $0.25-$0.30 in the fiscal year ending next March versus $0.13 last year, President and Chief Executive Officer George Wells said Tuesday.
In a telephone interview, Wells said, "We're looking at about $0.04 a share (for the second quarter)."
For the year, he said, "We're on target for doubling our earnings and ... as I have said previously... we expect our sales to be on the order of ... $70 million."
Holland, Ohio-based Centrum plans Thursday or Friday to report its second quarter, which is usually slow due to a slow July-September manufacturing cycle, he said.
Centrum's three operating companies -- a machine tool unit, a material handling company and a metal forming unit -- all have strong backlogs, he said.
"They've got a full plate for 12 months out," he said.
Centrum is actively seeking acquisitions and hopes to announce one or two, depending on the size, by the fiscal year end, he said.
Centrum crept into the black two years ago and in March completed its acquisition of McInnes Steel.
